scope: Measured, unexposed baseline only; one male ABCA-2 donor
cell_join: Exact cell_label; one-to-one; no reordering versus existing regional viewer; no dropped regional cells
gene_selection: Existing curated measured-top10 groups from gene_priorities; no new significance tests; all raw counts retained
coordinate_definition_en: Within-section x/y are the deposited experimentally measured coordinates after tissue rotation/alignment (mm); they are not CCF ML/DV coordinates. Experimental z is an estimated slice AP position. The 2D y-axis is displayed downward; numeric coordinates remain unchanged. The separate CCF AP/DV/ML coordinates are retained for 3D. No jitter, relocation, interpolation or mirroring.
coordinate_definition_es: Las x/y dentro de cada corte son las coordenadas experimentales depositadas tras la rotación/alineación del tejido (mm); no son coordenadas CCF ML/DV. La z experimental estima la posición AP del corte. El eje y 2D se muestra hacia abajo; los valores numéricos no cambian. Se conservan por separado las coordenadas CCF AP/DV/ML para 3D. Sin jitter, reubicación, interpolación ni espejo.
detection: Raw imaging count >0. n_positive/n_all measured regional cells in each explicitly identified group, including zeros.
anatomical_strata: ACA: all deposited ten layer/subdivision substructures; HY: deposited nuclear/subregion substructures, not cortical layers

binning.edges: Global multiples of0.1mm in deposited experimental slice x/y; floor(x/0.1),floor(y/0.1), half-open intervals [lower,upper)
binning.grouping: Separate bins per exact physical brain_section_label; never pool across sections
binning.denominator: All measured regional cells in that occupied bin; empty bins omitted as unobserved, not zero

section_example_selection: Region slice with largest measured cell n, independent of gene expression; ties resolved by AP order
section_spacing: Estimated experimental slice AP positions are deposited registration/sectioning estimates; nominal~200µm does not mean isotropic 3D sampling
uncertainty: No binomial cell-level confidence intervals or animal-level inference from one donor; anatomy/section proportions are descriptive
limitations: Cell counts are not independent animals
Detection also reflects assay sensitivity and deposited filtering/registration coverage
ACA/HY are registered subsets of one hemisphere, not complete bilateral measurements
These maps do not identify PM2.5 responses by cell type or location
No RNA imputation, new cells, relocation, jitter, mirrored hemisphere or values between measured sections
